XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Instrument panel

  • Fault: Speedometer malfunction: it sometimes gets stuck at zero, at other times at full scale or at a random value. The odometer records kilometres correctly and the other functions of the instrument cluster are working properly.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty instrument cluster

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the instrument cluster; repair or replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the fault was permanently resolved following the replacement of the instrument cluster.

    The estimated time for the service is approximately 1.3 hours.
